create_simple_tokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer from a BPE merges file to encode and decode text into token IDs
build_text_preprocessor: build a TextPreprocessor module with token embedding, positional encoding, and optional causal masking for text inputs
create_rgbdt_preprocessor: create an RGBDTPreprocessor to tokenize RGB and depth vision inputs with patch embedding and positional encoding
create_imu_preprocessor: create an IMUPreprocessor to patchify and tokenize IMU sensor data with positional and class tokens
build_causal_attention_mask: build a causal attention mask tensor for transformer models with a given context length
